cutoverRecommendation: Set GITHUB_TOKEN via secure entry + wrangler secret put (stdin); no redeploy needed.
Run the 500-candidate slice via POST /admin/enqueue-candidates; accept on sane rejection reasons, ~0 DLQ arrivals, sustained ≥ ~300 candidates/hr.
On accept: stop the sandbox drain and remove the watchdog cron (main-session actions; deliberately not done in this build).

Backlog feeding: the flag-gated daily step (100/day) is steady-state trickle only — loop the admin route (~500 per ~75 min of consumer capacity) or add a dedicated producer cron with its own scheduled() dispatch branch running only the producer step at page 500.
Leave QUEUE_DRAIN_ENABLED on after the backlog empties: empty pages are a harmless no-op and it feeds scout overflow thereafter.

githubToken.blocker: dynamic_credential_entry('custom.talents-github') → authd HTTP 403: connector credentials are not available to the sandbox; use the connector's privsep tool, or a custom.* connector whose policy allows sandbox use
githubToken.unblock: Provide the token via secure entry (privsep path), then `wrangler secret put GITHUB_TOKEN` with the value via stdin only. No redeploy needed — the fetch wrapper and the code-search scout read env.GITHUB_TOKEN at runtime.

producer.order: priority DESC, locator ASC, kind ASC (store.listCandidatePage)

sandboxDrain.observedAliveRateSourcesPerHour: 115-300 (batches of 25 per ~5-13 min, single-threaded, when alive)

slice.attributionMethod: Track the exact source ids returned in items[] by POST /admin/enqueue-candidates; poll those rows in D1 to terminal states (ingested/rejected/stale/mined); rows still candidate after queue-empty + retry window = DLQ set; record deltas from those rows' record_count changes only.
